blogs.title: How AI Can Be an Expert Feature Engineer for Your Data: Introducing FeatLLM
blogs.description: A deep dive into the core innovation of FeatLLM. This post explains how LLMs can shift from being the decision-maker to the architect, automatically translating complex tabular data into simple, human-understandable rules. We'll explore the concept of 'feature engineering done by AI' and how it creates a bridge between raw data and smart predictions without needing thousands of training examples.

blogs.title: Kicking Away the Ladders: Why FeatLLM Uses Simple Models at Inference Time
blogs.description: The common misconception that every AI application needs a massive, running LLM is shattered by FeatLLM. This blog post breaks down the 'train one, run many' philosophy of the paper, explaining how incorporating an LLM only once to generate rules allows for a super-efficient linear model to make predictions instantly. We'll discuss the cost-saving implications for real-world apps like healthcare dashboards and financial risk scoring.

blogs.title: Beating Senseless Complexity: How FeatLLM Handles Table Size Limits
blogs.description: One of the biggest hurdles in using LLMs on tabular data is when tables get too wide to fit in the input prompt. This post focuses on FeatLLM's clever use of 'bagging' (a technique borrowed from statistics). It demonstrates how generating features in batches allows researchers to tackle massive datasets with hundreds of columns that would otherwise crash standard LLM pipelines, making AI accessible for everything from complex supply chains to genomic research.
